title: Muse Video Bridge - CYD firmware flasher
profile: Target: one-USB ESP32-2432S028R resistive CYD, original ILI9341 reference profile. LCD controller/revision still needs visual qualification.
close_app: Close Muse Video Bridge and any serial monitor before continuing.
integrity_ok: Included firmware and esptool SHA-256 checks passed.
select_port: Enter the CYD's COM port (for example COM3)
no_ports: No serial port found. Connect the CYD with a data cable and check the CH340 driver in Device Manager.
invalid_port: Select a listed COM port. No port was opened.
identifying: Reading chip and flash identification at 115200 baud...
wrong_flash: This kit requires a classic ESP32 with detected 4 MB flash. Identification did not match; nothing was written.
confirm: Firmware will be overwritten on {0}. Confirm this is your one-USB resistive CYD. The microSD card will not be modified.
type_flash: Type FLASH to continue, or press Enter to cancel
skip_backup: Explicit skip-backup mode: existing firmware cannot be restored without a complete backup.
type_skip: Type SKIP to flash without a backup, or press Enter to cancel
backing_up: Reading a complete 4 MB flash backup. A read error stops flashing.
backup_exists: Backup filename already exists; preserving it and stopping.
backup_incomplete: Backup size is incomplete. Firmware was not written.
flashing: Writing the four firmware images at 115200 baud...
verifying: Comparing written flash against the included images...
complete: Flash verification passed; the ESP32 has been reset.
next: Check the waiting screen, then open Muse Video Bridge and select this COM port. See README.md for physical tests. This message does not verify the TFT or SD playback.
bad_manifest: Unsupported or invalid firmware manifest. Download/extract the complete flashing kit again.
bad_hash: SHA-256 or size verification failed: {0}. No firmware was written.
tool_failed: esptool failed (exit {0}). See the diagnostic output above.
recovery: If writing had started, firmware may be incomplete. Keep any backup, reconnect the device and rerun the kit. For connection errors see README.md; no automatic erase or SD format is performed.
windows_only: This helper runs on Windows. Use the documented PlatformIO workflow on Linux.
application_backup_required: Application-only updating requires a complete backup; SkipBackup is unavailable in this mode.
application_scope: Application-only update: compare the existing partition table after a full backup, then write only app0 at 0x10000. Bootloader, partition table, boot selection, NVS and other partitions stay untouched.
partition_mismatch: The backed-up partition table does not exactly match this build. Nothing was written. Preserve the backup and review the existing layout; there is no automatic full-flash fallback.
application_flashing: Writing only firmware.bin in app0 at 0x10000...
application_next: Boot selection is unchanged. Confirm the running firmware and physical playback; if it still starts another app slot, preserve the backup and stop for review.
